Role Permissions grant access to every document of a doctype, and User Permissions take most of it back. A User Permission that is missing, deleted, or never created therefore reads as unrestricted access.

Listing a doctype here adds a Require User Permission checkbox to each of its rows in the Role Permission Manager. A role with that box ticked sees nothing until the user holds the User Permission named below; a role without it is unaffected. So Employee can be gated to their own records while HR Manager keeps full access to the same doctype.

Adding a row takes effect after the next bench migrate, which creates the checkbox. Gated roles are also refused Query and Script Reports on these doctypes, because report SQL cannot honour User Permissions.
